Introducing study with me [pomodoro] 3 hours of lofi focus music, your ultimate Pomodoro companion for focused study and work sessions. This 3-hour mix features 78 carefully curated tracks, arranged into Pomodoro study loops to support a natural rhythm of focus and rest. Perfect as a cozy evening companion for homework or deep study, calming melodies and gently energizing rhythms carry you through hours of productive flow, one loop at a time. Set it up, let the timer begin and the magic happen
